class.name: IfcDimensionalExponents
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-41:1992 : The dimensionality of any quantity can be expressed as a product of powers of the dimensions of base quantities. The dimensional exponents entity defines the powers of the dimensions of the base quantities. All the physical quantities are founded on seven base quantities (ISO 31 (clause 2)). NOTE: Length, mass, time, electric current, thermodynamic temperatur

members.member: The power of the length base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
The power of the mass base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
The power of the time base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
The power of the electric current base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
The power of the thermodynamic temperature base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
The power of the amount of substance base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
The power of the luminous intensity base quantity. An int, or null when unset.
